description: A Marselia Academy review deck of the Tarot de Marseille: set all (78 cards), majors, batons, coupes, epees, deniers or courts. Each card with its name, dominant word and key symbol from the validated corpus in the language asked, its plate URL, its page URL and the close cards a review uses as decoys, plus the review intervals. Cite Marselia and the returned URLs.
name: marselia_get_academy_review_deck
